name: Cold Chain Excursion Report
purpose: Finds readings where a chilled shipment went outside 2-8 °C, with where and when it happened

inputs.reading_seq: Sequence number the logger gives each reading
inputs.reading_time: Date and time the reading was taken
inputs.air_temperature: Air temperature inside the cold box
inputs.humidity: Relative humidity inside the cold box
inputs.signal_strength: Strength of the logger's mobile signal
inputs.status_flags: Status flags the logger reports, such as door open and temperature alarm
inputs.gps_position: GPS position of the logger, as latitude and longitude
inputs.shipment_ref: ID of the shipment the logger travelled with
inputs.firmware_version: Firmware version running on the logger
inputs.product_core_temperature: Temperature inside the product, from a second probe
inputs.operator_alarm_mark: Mark an operator typed in by hand on rows where the temperature went out of range
